component.name: IPMIView
component.summary: Management software program based on the IPMI specification Reversion 1.5 - 2.0

description.p: IPMIView is a GUI-based software application allowing administrators to manage multiple target systems through BMC. IPMIView V2.0 supports Supermicro’s BMCs that adheres to either IPMI v1.5 or v2.0
